description.zh:
新的管控策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The new description of the access control policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length. The description can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.

description.zh:
新的管控策略内容。

最大长度为4096个字符。

管控策略语言，请参见[管控策略语言](~~179096~~)。

管控策略示例，请参见[自定义管控策略示例](~~181474~~)。
description.en:
The new document of the access control policy.

The document can be a maximum of 4,096 characters in length.

For more information about the languages of access control policies, see [Languages of access control policies](~~179096~~).

For more information about the examples of access control policies, see [Examples of custom access control policies](~~181474~~).

description.zh:
新的管控策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，必须以英文字母开头，可以包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）。
description.en:
The new name of the access control policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-) and must start with a letter.
The ID of the access control policy.

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，修改管控策略`cp-jExXAqIYkwHN****`的名称为`NewControlPolicy`。
descriptions.en: In this example, the name of the access control policy whose ID is `cp-jExXAqIYkwHN****` is changed to `NewControlPolicy`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager update-control-policy --policy-id cp-jExXAqIYkwHN0000 --new-policy-name NewControlPolicy --new-description ExampleControlPolicy --new-policy-document Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager UpdateControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --NewDescription ExampleControlPolicy --NewPolicyName NewControlPolicy --NewPolicyDocument 'Version_:_1_,_Statement_:_Effect_:_Deny_,_Action_:_ram:UpdateRole_,_ram:DeleteRole_,_ram:AttachPolicyToRole_,_ram:DetachPolicyFromRole_,_Resource_:_acs:ram:0:0:role/ResourceDirectoryAccountAccessRole' --PolicyId 'cp-jExXAqIYkwHN0000'
